<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_kp101_kpmg_res_0_user_project_assignment</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Update resource status</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

	if(!current.user) return;

	var resource = current.user;

	var profileGR = new GlideRecord('x_kp101_kpmg_res_0_resource_profile');
	if(!profileGR.get(resource)) return;

	var projectGR = new GlideRecord('x_kp101_kpmg_res_0_user_project_assignment');
		projectGR.addQuery('user', resource);
		projectGR.addQuery('deployment_status', 'active');
		projectGR.query();

		if(projectGR.hasNext()){

			if(profileGR.deployment_status != 'deployed') {
				profileGR.deployment_status = 'deployed';
				profileGR.update();
			}
		} else {

			if(profileGR.deployment_status == 'deployed'){
				profileGR.deployment_status = 'bench_training';
				profileGR.update();
			}
		}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mdcadag</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-30 03:32:12</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>6a81e9f13b604f50a154031f23e45a7c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update resource status</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="KPMG Resource Hub" source="x_kp101_kpmg_res_0">2d99e9272b948bd0a0e0f76a6e91bf71</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="KPMG Resource Hub">2d99e9272b948bd0a0e0f76a6e91bf71</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_6a81e9f13b604f50a154031f23e45a7c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mdcadag</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-30 04:22:53</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=6a81e9f13b604f50a154031f23e45a7c"/></record_update>
